models.score_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (artificialanalysis.ai leaderboard JSON, fetched 2026-11-02); cross-checked on the artificialanalysis.ai/models/ling-3-1-flash-1019 page data (intelligenceIndex 29.47)
models.notes: Released 2026-10-22 (AA release date; HF weights repo created 2026-10-27). Post-training refresh of Ling-3.1-flash (better agentic/science scores). Hybrid-linear MoE (BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM / bailing_hybrid): 72 layers = 63 KDA linear-attention + 9 gated-MLA full-attention layers (7:1, every 8th layer), first 4 layers dense, 512 routed experts top-8 + 1 shared, plus 1 MTP (NextN) layer. Card: 560B total / 25B active (572.12B = safetensors incl. MTP; AA also lists 25B active; the SGLang cookbook says 'about 17B active', so the active figure is UNVERIFIED beyond the vendor/AA number). KV: MLA latent 512 + 64 rope = 576 per token per full-attention layer (GGUF stores 1 KV head on those 9 layers); the 63 KDA layers keep a fixed-size recurrent state instead of a KV cache. Native context 262,144 (config, GGUF and SGLang cookbook); the advertised 1M (1,048,576) needs YaRN factor 4 (SGLang override; the llama.cpp equivalent --rope-scaling yarn --rope-scale 4 --yarn-orig-ctx 262144 is UNVERIFIED for this arch). Text only. No unsloth or ggml-org GGUFs; bartowski imatrix quants built with llama.cpp b11913. Every quant embeds the MTP layer (Q4_0, Q8_0 in the Q8_0 file), usable with --spec-type draft-mtp. llama.cpp: supported in b11960 (arch bailingmoe3).

models.name: MiMo V2.6 Pro
models.score_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (artificialanalysis.ai leaderboard JSON, fetched 2026-11-02); cross-checked on the artificialanalysis.ai/models/mimo-v2-6-pro page data (intelligenceIndex 29.89; AA links XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL)
models.notes: Released 2026-09-21. Flagship of MiMo-V2.6; AA's 'MiMo-V2.6-Pro' is this -RL checkpoint (the later -MOPD upgrade, which fixes tool-call repetition, has no separate AA score). Omnimodal sparse MoE: text/image/video/audio in (mmproj-MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL-Q8_0.gguf, 1.61GB, in the same repo); 1.02T total (1,024.22B safetensors) / 42B active, 384 experts top-8, no shared experts; 70 layers = 60 sliding-window (128) + 10 global-attention, 128 Q / 8 KV heads, head_dim 192 (V 128), attention sinks on the SWA layers. Native MXFP4 experts, so the MXFP4 GGUF is effectively full quality; the Q2_K keeps the expert down-projections at MXFP4 and has no imatrix. Only ggml-org quants exist for -RL (no unsloth/bartowski). AesSedai has smaller BPW2.0-3.5 quants (255.8-447.5 GB) for -MOPD only. The draft is the 3-layer MTP sidecar (--spec-type draft-mtp); the repo also ships a 5-layer DFlash drafter (dflash-MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL-Q8_0.gguf, 4.94GB). GGUFs were converted with llama.cpp commit 4ebdf2c (2026-10-02, an ancestor of b11960). llama.cpp: supported in b11960 (arch mimo2; MTP draft support since PR #26228). Open llama.cpp issue #29931 reports tool-call JSON corruption at long context with MiMo-V2.6 over RPC.
